name: Champion audience families v1 - finalized 87.5% cohort

reference_pool.definition: Unique reviewed 5-28 champion compositions; exact current composition excluded; newly searched compositions do not enter denominator.

relative_jaccard: Mean weighted audience Jaccard to included peers / median of this champion's mean Jaccards across its other reviewed family compositions, all under the selected source context; self excluded.
evidence_limits: Source-selected descriptive evidence, not independent validation or individual-choice prediction.
Manual subsets do not inherit parent recovery; source matrices remain separate.
The 87.5% floor and frozen reviewed-pool median are accepted review choices, not population parameters.
This definition is not yet wired into serving data or player categorization.
